title: Avatar
description: Display user profile pictures or icons

body.raw:
<AvatarPreview />

##### Installation

<Code language="bash" code={`npx radianos add avatar`} />

##### Imports

<Code language="tsx" code={`import {Avatar} from "@/components/ui/avatar"`} />

##### Props

| Prop Name  | Default Values | Values                                   |
| ---------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| size       | base           | xxs, xs, sm, base, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl |
| showOnline | false          | true, false                              |
